package.name: nero_motion_planning
package.description:
Task-space manipulation sequencing for the NERO arm: turns a grasp or place target into an ordered waypoint sequence (staging, pregrasp standoff, linear approach, gripper action, linear retreat, staging, home), then hands that sequence to a swappable motion backend.
The backend is the seam: MoveIt (CHOMP + compute_cartesian_path, executed via nero_joint_control) today, an impedance controller consuming joey_interfaces/PoseCommand tomorrow. Path generation is pure geometry and knows about neither.
